voiceover_script.hook: Stop choosing the wrong editor in 2026! Here is the honest developer verdict on IntelliJ IDEA.
voiceover_script.pricing_segment: Pricing breakdown: Freemium (Community Free / Ultimate $169+/yr). Paid Ultimate Edition for Full Enterprise & Framework Support.
voiceover_script.pros_segment: Why developers love it: Industry-leading Java, Kotlin, and Spring framework code intelligence, Incredible automated refactoring and static analysis engines, Deep database management, HTTP client, and enterprise tooling integration.
voiceover_script.cons_segment: What you need to watch out for: Heavy memory footprint (requires 8GB+ RAM allocation), Ultimate features locked behind commercial annual license.
voiceover_script.recommendation_callout: Final Recommendation: Unmatched industry standard for Java, Kotlin, and enterprise backend engineering.
